xml_content: dang po ni kha cig na re mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni de ma yin las tha dad du 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan nam mtshon bya rnam 'jog gi rgyu mtshan zhes bya ba yin no zhes zer ro || This view is also mentioned in Rigs gter rang 'grel (ID:5564) [CXRAK3IW] VIII 186,14 (mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid mtshon bya rnam 'jog gi rgyu mtshan yin na…). Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 163,8, Rigs gter rol mtsho [32NTDJ66] Dza 70b1 (=586) and Rigs gter pham byed [7YPPPJ75] Tha 128a5 (=255) identify it as rNgog Lo tsa ba chen po (ID: 3786)'s view.
